title: Database Maintenance and Diagnostics Toolkit
objective: Inspect versions, schema, indexes, integrity, query plans, backups and file size without modifying originals without consent.

milestones.title: Define requirements and schema
acceptance_criteria: State the workload, data entities, expected queries and integrity requirements.
Document assumptions, dataset shape and how the schema will be checked.

milestones.title: Implement queries and application workflow
acceptance_criteria: Use parameter binding for application-supplied values.
Test normal and invalid cases using a deterministic fixture.

milestones.title: Verify reliability and document decisions
acceptance_criteria: Include integrity/migration/recovery checks appropriate to the project.
Explain measured trade-offs, runtime support and operational limitations.

stretch_features: Add FTS5 or JSON only after checking feature availability.
Add a repeatable benchmark based on representative data.
Automate backup restore and migration regression tests.
tests_and_evidence: Provide seed data and exact run commands.
Record expected results and actual test outcomes.
Include at least one failure-path test and one data-integrity test.
review_method: Human review required; no automated arbitrary SQL sandbox is assumed.
status_note: Project brief is prepared from the supplied PDF; reference outline is not a fully executable application.
